findings.detail: Publication recovery attempts to write its invalidation record under daily/.../qa/, but the inherited put_immutable method accepts only cloud_pilot/live_artifacts/ paths. The real recovery path therefore raises ARTIFACT_PATH before invalidation or fence release. The regression test uses a fake transport that does not enforce this restriction.
findings.required_fix: Add a narrowly scoped, immutable canonical QA writer and test recovery through the real transport path constraints, including expired evidence and a subsequent research epoch.

findings.detail: A source retrieval or archive failure produces only a generic halt. Successfully collected partial evidence, the failed source, blocked facts and a canonical research verdict are not persisted, so the required research handoff is missing.
findings.required_fix: Persist a non-writing-ready research failure with the available source log, access failure, blocked facts and handoff before stopping. Test failure at each source position.

findings.detail: check_research rejects every non-ready result before validating its verdict, and persist_failed_research unconditionally changes the result to RESEARCH_FAIL. A valid non-ready RESEARCH_CONDITIONAL verdict is therefore misreported as FAIL, and malformed responses can lack the required blocked-fact fields.
findings.required_fix: Validate and persist PASS, CONDITIONAL and FAIL separately, preserving legitimate non-ready conditional status and its boundaries. For malformed output, create an explicitly incomplete failure record with the missing fields and no writing readiness.

findings.detail: The canonical handoff and source log omit mandatory publish-grade fields. In particular, source rows do not record source titles or supported facts, while HANDOFF.json lacks required allowed/blocked facts, source counts and scope status. Those values being partly available in other packet files does not make the handoff complete.
findings.required_fix: Build and validate the complete per-package handoff and source log from directly supported evidence, including titles, supported facts, source counts, scope, allowed and blocked facts, confidence and applicable identity fields.

findings.detail: The startup synchronization is recorded only in the operational journal, not in the Daily Manifest or RESEARCH_READY startup block as required. After research completes, the active path starts writing without the prescribed writing-stage pull and pre-writing startup checklist.
findings.required_fix: Record actual startup identifiers in the canonical batch artifact and perform and document the required writing-stage synchronization and checklist against the completed research baseline before any writing call.

cloud-pilot-manual.yml.content:
name: AutoBridge multilingual API pilot
on:
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      mode:
        description: Offline inspection or separately approved real execution
        type: choice
        options: [preflight, account-check, audit, execute]
        default: preflight
permissions:
  contents: read
concurrency:
  group: autobridge-entire-real-pilot-program
  cancel-in-progress: false
jobs:
  trusted:
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    uses: xysjou/AutoBridge-Content-Pipeline/.github/workflows/cloud-pilot-trusted.yml@b3f5a6cef20b8dc235f001af306e635f1eca0fdf
    with:
      mode: ${{ inputs.mode }}
    secrets:
      OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
      AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT }}
      AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256 }}

cloud-pilot-trusted.yml.content:
name: AutoBridge pinned protected runtime
on:
  workflow_call:
    inputs:
      mode:
        type: string
        required: true
    secrets:
      OPENAI_API_KEY:
        required: true
      AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT:
        required: true
      AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256:
        required: true
permissions:
  contents: read
jobs:
  inspect:
    if: inputs.mode == 'preflight'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA || github.sha }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - run: python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual preflight
  account-check:
    # Availability is inspected inside the code/lease-preauthorized execute path.
    # Disable the legacy standalone key-bearing path permanently.
    if: ${{ false }}
    environment: autobridge-pilot
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Inspect only the two configured model metadata endpoints
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_ACCOUNT_CHECK_APPROVED: 'true'
        run: python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual account-check
  execute:
    if: >-
      (inputs.mode == 'execute' || inputs.mode == 'audit') &&
      vars.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_ENABLED == 'true' &&
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/integration/work-cloud-pilot-m1-20261102'
    environment: autobridge-pilot
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 180
    permissions:
      contents: write
      pull-requests: write
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262
        with:
          ref: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
          persist-credentials: false
          fetch-depth: 0
      - uses: actions/setup-python@a26af69be951a213d495a4c3e4e4022e16d87065
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'
      - name: Fetch reviewed control documents from a separate immutable commit
        env:
          AUTOBRIDGE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVAL_COMMIT: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_CONTROL_COMMIT }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA: ${{ vars.AUTOBRIDGE_APPROVED_CODE_SHA }}
        run: python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual.control
      - name: Validate exact run and workflow lease before exposing the project key
        env:
          AUTOBRIDGE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256 }}
        run: >-
          python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual preauthorize
          --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-plan.json"
          --prices "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-prices.json"
          --permit "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-permit.json"
      - name: Execute approved phase with the existing whole-program budget
        env:
          OPENAI_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.OPENAI_API_KEY }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256: ${{ secrets.AUTOBRIDGE_LIVE_APPROVAL_SHA256 }}
          APPROVED_RUN_MODE: ${{ inputs.mode }}
        run: >-
          python3 -m cloud_pilot.multilingual "$APPROVED_RUN_MODE"
          --plan "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-plan.json"
          --prices "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-prices.json"
          --permit "$RUNNER_TEMP/autobridge-approved/approved-permit.json"

articles.reason: The reserve covers a China-market 2024 Q05 PHEV reference, while this topic is an urban-sourcing shortlist decision for an identified 2026 Q05 BEV, including stock, charging, service and exact-trim checks. The shared Q05 name alone does not establish identical vehicle identity or duplicate intent; keep the year, powertrain and configuration boundaries explicit.

The existing reefer pages focus on chassis, body, refrigeration-unit specifications and sourcing checks; fleet procurement covers broader tender acceptance, while PDI covers general pre-shipment handover and carrier rules. This proposed guide has a distinct completed-truck acceptance-evidence decision scope: identity, cargo and ambient conditions, sensor records, door-opening pattern, power modes and responsibility allocation. Keep it centered on the acceptance demonstration rather than repeating equipment-selection advice.
